root_causes.finding: Every valid pilot Regional failure is solely global_composite below 90; identity, eyes/brows, geometry and preservation gates pass.
global_composite is copied directly from Image Validator overall_score, whose B03/B04 issues include full-body/action-incompatible default-DNA expectations: shot_distance and hairstyle.
No Linh An B03/B04 scenario overlay exists; validate_image supports scenario_profile_id but the executed score producer does not pass one.

A face-only workflow cannot remove the decisive shot_distance mismatch and cannot reliably correct hairstyle length outside the editable mask; therefore workflow-only tuning is unlikely to make B03+B04 global_composite pass.

rejected_tuning_axes: denoise below 0.30: C2=0.25 and C3=0.20 did not improve B03
crop geometry, alignment, mask dilation, mask feather: no evidence of a failure; geometry and Pixel Lock pass
CFG, sampler, scheduler: no causal evidence and no expected path to the outside-mask shot-distance mismatch

candidates.technical_hypothesis: More diffusion steps may improve the existing technical_quality=85 face detail without changing denoise.
candidates.expected_improvement: Face detail only; no supported expectation that it resolves global_composite.
candidates.main_risk: More reconstruction drift and GPU time; cannot affect shot_distance.
candidates.precondition: Run only after R1-T2 proves scenario-aware global validation is authority-equivalent or rejects the blocker.
candidates.stop_condition: Stop after either case fails Face-QC, Pixel Lock, or Regional; do not benchmark.

candidates.technical_hypothesis: A modest FaceID conditioning increase may improve identity-specific details while keeping A2_FRONT and all sampler settings fixed.
candidates.expected_improvement: Identity fidelity only; baseline identity already passes, so pass impact is unproven.
candidates.main_risk: Over-conditioning can alter pose/lighting or reduce geometry agreement.
candidates.precondition: Run only after R1-T2 and as a content-addressed derived workflow, not a production replacement.
candidates.stop_condition: Stop after either case fails Face-QC, Pixel Lock, or Regional; do not benchmark.

candidates.technical_hypothesis: A modest adapter-strength increase may improve local face texture/ear detail under the same A2 reference.
candidates.expected_improvement: Local face/ear detail only; no supported expectation that it resolves outside-mask Image-QC issues.
candidates.main_risk: Plasticity or pose drift; baseline technical quality is already the weakest Face-QC category.
candidates.precondition: Run only after R1-T2 and as a content-addressed derived workflow, not a production replacement.
candidates.stop_condition: Stop after either case fails Face-QC, Pixel Lock, or Regional; do not benchmark.

requirements: B03 Regional pass at unchanged thresholds
B04 Regional pass at unchanged thresholds
pilot_gate.winner_rule: Select a winner only when every requirement passes for B03 and B04.
pilot_gate.no_winner_rule: If no candidate passes B03+B04, record NO_WINNER and stop before B01-B10.
